Bill.BriefDescription: Providing enhanced funding for crime victim services and prosecutorial costs.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing enhanced funding for crime victimservices and prosecutorial costs; adding a new section to chapter 43.31RCW; and making an appropriation.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.31 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department of community, trade, and economic developmentshall establish a grant program to enhance the funding, treatment, andservices for victims of felony crimes and for enhanced localprosecutorial costs. (2) Funding may be used to build on efforts by existing communityprograms, coordinating those efforts, or developing cooperating efforts to make the most effective use of resources to provide services tovictims and to prosecute a greater number of felony cases. (3) Funds shall be disbursed through a request for proposalprocess.

The sum of five hundred thousand dollars, oras much thereof as may be necessary, is appropriated for the biennium p. 1 HB 2828ending June 30, 2009, from the general fund to the department ofcommunity, trade, and economic development for the purposes of section1 of this act.
